description: Turn a square product photo into an Instagram or Facebook Story ad image on a 9:16 canvas, with room left for your headline, price and button.
h1: Instagram Story Ad Images Built Around a Square Product Photo
lead: A feed photo cropped to Stories rarely leaves room for your headline or button. Upload one product photo and get a square image composed to sit inside a 9:16 Story ad.
benefits_h2: Why sellers use Instagram Story ad images

benefits.t: Built for the full phone screen
benefits.d: The product sits centered on a 9:16 canvas with calm space above and below, so your headline and offer avoid the item.
The product stays away from the top header and lower action area, keeping stickers and the call-to-action button visible.
Place the same square download in Instagram and Facebook Story layouts, and reuse it in feeds, carousels and listings.
Type prices, dates and codes in Canva or Ads Manager after download. The image carries no watermark.

steps_h2: How to make Instagram Story ad images in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One product photo becomes a Story-ready square scene, with all text added outside the image.

steps.d: Show one complete product with open space around it.
Name a surface, light direction and one prop in one sentence.

faq.q: Can the Story image include my price or code?
faq.a: Add it after download in Canva, CapCut or Ads Manager. The generated image contains no text, so nothing is misspelled.

faq.q: Does the template output a 9:16 file?
faq.a: It outputs a square photo composed for a Story layout. Place it on a 9:16 canvas in your design tool and add the text.

faq.q: Why not just crop a square photo for Stories?
faq.a: A cropped feed photo can cut off the product and leave no room for text. This template keeps the full item centered with open space.

faq.q: Can I use the image in Facebook Stories and feeds?
faq.a: Yes. The same square image works in Instagram and Facebook Story layouts, feed posts, carousels and listing galleries.

faq.q: When should I use a 9:16 video instead?
faq.a: Choose a full-screen video when you need motion to show the product in use. Use this square photo for a simple offer and product view.

faq.q: How much does a Story photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, and the charge is shown before you start. Downloads carry no watermark.

visual.overview: This template turns one product photo into a square scene made for a Story layout, with the product clear of the header, stickers and action button. Place it on a 9:16 canvas and add your offer text after download.
